detailed_description: YAML Formatter formats pasted YAML text in the browser using js-yaml. You can edit the sample YAML, choose 2-space or 4-space indentation, click Format, review parse errors when js-yaml rejects the input, copy the formatted output, or clear the input, output, and error message. It does not upload YAML files, automatically repair invalid YAML, provide schema-aware validation for Kubernetes or CI/CD files, preserve comments, offer multi-document controls, or guarantee support for every YAML edge case.
usage_steps: Paste YAML into the input textarea or edit the built-in sample.
Click Format to parse and dump the YAML.
Review any parse error shown above the textareas.
Copy the formatted result or clear the tool.
usage_examples: Reformat a small pasted YAML configuration with 2-space indentation.
Switch to 4-space indentation before copying the formatted output.
Check whether js-yaml reports a parse error for a short YAML snippet.
Clear the sample and format another browser-side YAML value.
